cards.q: What was the Great Vowel Shift?
cards.a: A series of pronunciation changes in the vowels of the English language.

cards.q: Which class of Middle English vowels had their pronunciation altered by the Great Vowel Shift?
What consonant change is occasionally included under the term Great Vowel Shift?
Why do English spellings now often deviate considerably from the pronunciations they represent?
cards.a: The Great Vowel Shift is the major reason, alongside spelling standardization that began in the 15th and 16th centuries.

cards.q: Between which years did the Great Vowel Shift primarily take place?
Which century formed the transition period from Middle English to Early Modern English?
Where did the Great Vowel Shift begin?
Who coined the term "Great Vowel Shift"?
cards.a: Otto Jespersen, in Part I (1909) of A Modern English Grammar on Historical Principles.

cards.q: Who first produced a diagram of the Great Vowel Shift?
cards.a: Otto Jespersen, a Danish linguist and Anglicist.

cards.q: Who wrote A History of English Sounds (1874, revised edition 1888)?
Which Vienna-based researcher published Untersuchungen zur englischen Lautgeschichte (1896)?
